def factor_volume_price_beta_logvol(df):
    """Rolling beta of return on log volume change measures stable volume-price coupling."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret_1 = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    vol_log = np.log(df_copy["volume"].replace(0, np.nan))
    vol_1 = vol_log.diff()
    cov = ret_1.rolling(20, min_periods=5).cov(vol_1)
    var = vol_1.rolling(20, min_periods=5).var()
    beta = cov / var.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    beta = beta.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    df_copy["factor_volume_price_beta_logvol"] = beta
    return df_copy["factor_volume_price_beta_logvol"]
description: This child preserves the parent's core volume-price coupling beta mechanism but replaces raw volume pct_change with log volume change. Log transformation reduces right skew and extreme outlier influence from low-base volume spikes, stabilizing the covariance denominator and improving IC/ICIR without altering the economic interpretation: a high positive beta still indicates informed flow, while a negative beta still signals divergence. The rolling window and min_periods remain unchanged to preserve the parent's RankIC/RankICIR and payoff profile.
